# MiChan

> 2,222 crystal cats on BNB Chain. First mint FREE for Agent ID holders; paid mints open to everyone.

- Mint page: https://michan-two.vercel.app/
- Market: https://michan-two.vercel.app/market.html
- Agent skill: https://michan-two.vercel.app/agent-skill.md

## Spec

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56), BEP-721, sequential IDs 1–2,222
- Supply: 2,222 — Common 1–1,111, Uncommon 1,112–1,666, Rare 1,667–1,999, Epic 2,000–2,154, Legendary 2,155–2,222
- Mint: #1 FREE (Agent ID only, via agent), #2 0.001 BNB, #3 0.003 BNB (public, wallet); max 3 per wallet (1 free + 2 paid)
- Gate: FREE mint — Binance Agentic Wallet + SPACE ID .ai Agent ID (on-chain check). Paid mints — public, no Agent ID needed, flat BNB.
- Royalty: 5%. Revenue forwards to owner wallet in-tx.
- Token: MICH — 120,000 per paid mint, 1B total (540M pool / 460M treasury), max 240,000 per wallet. No price, no liquidity yet.
- Market: fixed-price escrow, 0% platform fee, 5% creator royalty.
